summary: First Phosphate Corp., a Canadian mineral exploration company, announced via Form 6-K the uplisting of its Level 1 ADRs from OTCQX to a Level 2 ADR program on Nasdaq Global Market under ticker PHOS, effective August 10, 2026. The Level 1 ADRs were automatically delisted from OTCQX and converted to Level 2 ADRs. No new shares or capital raised; ADR ratio remains 10 common shares per ADR. BNY Mellon serves as depositary. This is a listing move rather than a special situation, but triggers a delisting from OTCQX.
